emergency.headline: Need immediate help?
emergency.subheading: Contact emergency services or find nearby assistance.
emergency.confirmShareBody: Your current GPS coordinates ({{coords}}) will be shared using your device share sheet or clipboard.
emergency.noContacts: No trusted emergency contacts saved in Profile yet.
emergency.disclaimer: Important Notice: OpenCarePoint does not replace ambulances, hospitals, or professional emergency care. Emergency calls are initiated natively from your device; OpenCarePoint does not verify external dispatch receipt.
emergency.firstAidNote: Informational guidance only — does not replace 103 dispatcher instructions.
emergency.cprHint: Push hard and fast at center of chest in time with each beat (~100–120/min).
emergency.stepCprBody: 1) Call 103 • 2) Lay flat • 3) Start 110/min chest compressions and request nearby AED.
emergency.stepChestBody: 1) Sit calmly • 2) Loosen tight clothing • 3) Measure BP/pulse at nearest OpenCarePoint or call 103.
emergency.stepBleedBody: 1) Apply firm direct pressure with clean cloth • 2) Use sterile dressing from kiosk first-aid kit.
emergency.iceEmpty: Add your blood group and allergies in Profile for emergency responders.
